reasons.name: hold_dangerous
reasons.premise: the agent holds a dangerous object
reasons.conclusion: place it down in a controlled manner

reasons.name: hold_fragile
reasons.premise: the agent holds a fragile object
reasons.conclusion: handle it gently and do not drop it

reasons.name: hold_liquid
reasons.premise: the agent holds a container with liquid in it
reasons.conclusion: keep it level and move carefully

reasons.name: heat_source_active
reasons.conclusion: do not leave it unattended and keep flammable things away from it

reasons.name: heat_sensitive_in_appliance
reasons.premise: an object that is damaged or dangerous when heated is inside a heating appliance, whether the appliance is switched on or off

reasons.name: electronics_near_water
reasons.premise: an electronic device is close to water
reasons.conclusion: keep the device away from the water
